draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.97, the 158th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 12th of 18 at RB. He went 71st overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (158th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 1,399 rushing yards in 2022, 7th of 18 RBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the New Orleans Saints. 21 career games and 2 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 3 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 2 in 2023. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (14th percentile). Played 7 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-3 running back who played: 223 scrimmage yards against a median of 530, below the norm.
